answer: Anchor every payout to a cedar of earned seniority: rewards scale with the depth of an identity's continuous activity rings, so a fresh key starts at zero and cannot buy past a real history. Each claim leaves a plume of traceable funding and work records in the public ledger, and any account sharing an umber funding sink with another loses its seniority multiplier, merging both into one effective share. Cloning therefore divides a farm's influence further, since every extra identity restarts the seniority clock from its first ring while inheriting the same funding shadow.
